problem: For a keyword that drives revenue, AI search cites a named competitor and never your brand. A content marketer has no repeatable way to prove the gap, or to rewrite a page so it becomes citable without inventing statistics along the way.
job: Given one brief, decide whether a real citation gap exists, and if it does, produce a citation-gap report plus one rewritten page section in which every fact traces to a captured evidence field.
boundary: Drafts copy only. Does not publish, touch a CMS, do keyword research, cover ChatGPT or Perplexity, or claim the rewrite will earn a citation.

evidence.query: best bible study app for left-handed theologians
